latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Content Remix Studio.

- Instantly transforms a single piece of content into optimized versions for YouTube, TikTok, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Instagram, newsletters, and blogs.
- Adapts tone, format, length, and style to match each platform’s audience and algorithm best practices.
- Supports diverse input formats—video scripts, blog posts, podcast transcripts, presentations, and more.
- Provides detailed, platform-specific strategies—hooks, engagement tactics, hashtags, calls-to-action, and publishing guidance.
- Includes examples and strategic tips for multi-platform content planning and cross-promotion.
